status: pre-registered before any trial account exists; score after the account phase
how_to_score: Each prediction states a measurable quantity and a pass/fail rule. Record the observed value, the run date, n, and whether the prediction held. Do not edit the predictions after the account exists.

predictions.task: onboarding to first browser test call
predictions.prediction: Sign-up (email or Google, Cloudflare Turnstile) to the first browser 'Talk' call on a template or Composer-built assistant takes <= 10 min (point 6 min), with no card required thanks to $5 free credits.
predictions.holds_if: median of 2 runs <= 10 min and no card prompt before the first browser call

predictions.task: first live PSTN call to our Indian handset
predictions.prediction: Cannot be done with Vapi alone. The free Vapi number is US, inbound-only and blocked from campaigns. It needs a second vendor account (Twilio, Telnyx or Vonage) with card, verification and India geo-permission, and shows an international (+1) CLI. Time from sign-up to first ring on our handset >= 45 min (point 75 min) when the Twilio account already exists; otherwise not same-day.
predictions.holds_if: >= 45 min, or a second vendor account is required, or the CLI shown is non-Indian

predictions.task: build the standard agent (Hinglish renewal-reminder spec)
predictions.prediction: Succeeds in 15-35 min, but only after manual provider choice. Defaults (English endpointing, English voices) do not hold Hinglish: we must pick a multilingual transcriber (Deepgram multi/Flux multi or Google), a Hindi-capable voice, and turn LiveKit smart endpointing off. With automatic language detection left on, >= 1 of 2 Hinglish test calls replies in a non-Hindi Indian language or English for >= 3 turns.
predictions.holds_if: build succeeds AND (manual multilingual config needed OR the language misfire reproduces)

predictions.task: upload messy 50-row synthetic CSV (duplicates, bad numbers, Hindi names, empty columns, an opt-out row)
predictions.prediction: Awkward or fail. (a) Any row with an empty number rejects the whole file. (b) 10-digit numbers without +91 are silently turned into '+98...'/'+7...'/'+6...' (wrong countries) or '+0...' and only fail later. (c) Duplicates are dialled twice. (d) The opt-out row is dialled unless we build a pre-dial webhook. (e) A 'Number' or 'Phone' header instead of lowercase 'number' fails. Devanagari names <= 40 chars pass; empty cells are dropped as variables.

Awkward. A 3-day 10:00-21:00 IST schedule needs 3 separate campaigns (one absolute window each, max 7 days ahead, 15-min steps, one time zone). Unanswered or busy contacts are not retried; contacts still pending at latestAt are dropped. Total clicks >= 3x a single-campaign setup.
predictions.holds_if: no recurring daily window AND no per-contact retry setting found in the UI

predictions.prediction: Voicemail detection and the transfer tool both configure in < 20 min. On Indian mobiles (which rarely have voicemail), operator announcements ('switched off', 'not reachable', 'busy', in Hindi/English) are misclassified or held open until the silence timeout on >= 30% of such calls. Warm transfer to a +91 number works only over the international Twilio leg, adding about INR 4.7/min for the second leg.
predictions.holds_if: misclassification or hold-open >= 30% on >= 6 network-announcement calls

predictions.task: find a failed call and its reason
predictions.prediction: Succeeds in <= 5 min via call logs filtered by ended reason. The reason is an engineering code (e.g. customer-did-not-answer, twilio-failed-to-connect-call, call.in-progress.error-vapifault-*) with no business interpretation or suggested fix, unless Call Health or Monitoring is enabled.
predictions.holds_if: found in <= 5 min AND reason shown only as a code

predictions.prediction: Call export to CSV (selected columns) or JSON succeeds in <= 5 min. Campaign-level outcomes (per-contact status plus structured outputs in one sheet) need either the API (/v2/campaign/:id/contacts plus /call) or a join done by the buyer.
predictions.holds_if: export works AND no single campaign-results export with structured outputs exists

predictions.task: handset reply gap on Indian PSTN (our spec, best-effort tuned)
predictions.prediction: Handset-side clean-turn reply gap p50 is 2.4-3.4 s (point 2.9 s) and p90 >= 4.0 s on calls from Vapi (US-West orchestration, Twilio international leg) to an Indian mobile. Tuned best case p50 >= 1.8 s. Cut-in at the 2.4 s elderly pause on >= 1 of 2 calls; collisions >= 15% of caller turns.
predictions.basis: l4b demo p50 2.32 s from US-East (CMP-02); VAP-20 (us-west-2 orchestration), VAP-43 (international leg); ~0.25 s extra RTT India-US West per exchange (inference)

predictions.prediction: Real billed cost of an Indian outbound connected minute (Vapi invoice + Twilio invoice) is INR 12-18 at FX 95, with the Vapi hosting fee >= 30% of the total.
